response.sql: WITH color_counts AS (SELECT p.product_color AS color, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_items, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM color_counts), kept AS (SELECT cc.color, cc.cnt, 1.0 * cc.cnt / t.total_items AS share, cc.cnt - t.avg_cnt AS excess FROM color_counts cc CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE cc.cnt > t.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: "Invoice line items" means rows in Invoice_Line_Items, each joined to Products on product_id to get its color. Each row counts once.
Products with NULL color form one group, as the request specifies. GROUP BY places all NULLs together. Empty-string colors, if any, are treated as a separate group from NULL.

The per-color average is the unweighted mean of the color group counts, and each color's share is its count divided by the total line item count across all colors. Averages over an empty kept set return NULL.
